description: Swedish company by organisationsnummer (556703-7485 or SE556703748501) or name, from Bolagsverket and SCB: names, legal form, registration date, status, deregistration, bankruptcy, liquidation or reconstruction, VAT/F-tax/employer activity, SNI codes, business description, address. Weekly open data. Use to verify a Swedish customer or supplier before invoicing. Register facts only, not a credit report. Example: orgnr=556703-7485. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

checkVat.description: true to also check the VAT number live in the EU VIES service (adds about a second)

limit.description: Matches for a name search (1-10, default 5)

name.description: Company name to search for, instead of orgnr: up to 10 registered companies whose name holds every word

orgnr.description: Swedish organisationsnummer (10 digits, with or without the hyphen) or Swedish VAT number (give orgnr or name)

name: se_company
title: Swedish company lookup, Bolagsverket register
